$comment: The full case: every part of the row and the meta line, with a type that has an accent, two topics, and a summary and title whose & < > " the two sides must escape alike. Each value is in the form the REST API gives it: title.rendered as get_the_title() texturizes it, term names as core stores them (& as &), the summary as MetaRules stores it, date_gmt without its Z. Topics are in get_the_terms() order, by name. README.md, "Markup fixtures", has the cases and the rules.
